name: OpenWebRX-Plus
description: Browser-based, multi-user software-defined radio receiver with a live spectrum and waterfall, browser audio, scanning, recording, analog modes, digital decoders, and SoftMBE digital voice support.

paths.name: Configuration
paths.description: Persistent OpenWebRX+ configuration and user database.

paths.name: Application data
paths.description: Persistent bookmarks, recordings, decoder output, and runtime data.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: OpenWebRX+ browser interface. Change the host port if 8073 is already in use.

variables.name: Time zone
variables.description: IANA time zone name, for example America/Los_Angeles.

variables.name: Admin username
variables.description: Initial administrator username. The image creates this account on first start if it does not already exist.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: Initial administrator password. Required on first installation and masked in the Unraid form.

devices.name: SDR USB bus
devices.description: USB device tree used to access attached SDR hardware. Remove this mapping for a network-only SDR.
